purpose: 1200s campus closed loop of HT-window/return recovery fixes

candidate_runtime.source_hash_scope: frozen hashes are actual compiled source bytes; git_lf_source_sha256 normalizes CRLF to LF as Git does for these source paths.
candidate_runtime.limitations: Compiled offline candidate. Historical runtime installations and previous20min evidence are unchanged; next test must explicitly source candidate/install last. No new Gazebo run or formal budget consumed.

duration_basis: Wall-clock after input readiness, continue after finish/parking; simulation advance separately reported
context_capture: Original inference inputs every60s, no warmup burst; diagnostic serialization is additional host I/O and not new terrain evidence
random_seed: No common explicit seed; trajectories are not a controlled performance attribution
